_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Discovery profile UML. Aligned to metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifDiscovery/schema.yaml. Standalone module (composes: []); the composite profile (CoreDiscovery) chains Core in. Restored content from the resolvedSchema: GeoSPARQL geometry (Geometry / AbstractGeometry + GeoCoordinates / GeoShape), OWL-Time (Instant / TimePosition) - intentional exception to the ProperInterval->string union shorthand because the BB defines real structure - and DQV (QualityMeasure metric definition + QualityMeasurement measurement instance). DefinedTerm and VariableMeasured are fattened with the controlled-vocabulary / quantitative-value attributes the schema actually requires.

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Discovery Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Discovery extension: measurement technique, variable measured, spatial / temporal coverage (with GeoSPARQL + OWL-Time), quality measurement
targetModel.definition: CDIF Discovery profile module. Discovery-oriented extensions on top of a cdifCore Dataset: schema:measurementTechnique, schema:variableMeasured (VariableMeasured), schema:spatialCoverage (SpatialExtent with GeoSPARQL geometry), schema:temporalCoverage (TemporalExtent with OWL-Time Instant), dqv:hasQualityMeasurement. The catalog record MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.1.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Discovery extension properties for a CDIF Dataset.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Discovery-specific value classes: VariableMeasured (schema:PropertyValue), SpatialExtent (schema:Place), TemporalExtent, QualityMeasure / QualityMeasurement.

package.name: Geometry
package.definition: GeoSPARQL geometry classes (Geometry + GeoCoordinates / GeoShape via AbstractGeometry) carrying schema:latitude, schema:longitude, schema:box, schema:line, geosparql:asWKT, geosparql:crs.

package.name: Time
package.definition: OWL-Time Instant + TimePosition - the structured form of a temporal-extent endpoint (intentional exception to the time:ProperInterval -> string union shorthand).

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of CDIFCore classes this profile attaches to. Full definitions live in CDIFCore.

class._comment: Dataset stub - the host node the discovery properties attach to. Full definition in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of schema:Dataset (full definition in CDIFCore). The discovery profile adds measurementTechnique / variableMeasured / spatialCoverage / temporalCoverage / hasQualityMeasurement to this Dataset.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the dataset.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - the metadata-about-this-resource node carried at schema:subjectOf on the Dataset.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord. For the discovery profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.1.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.1 for the discovery profile.

class._comment: DefinedTerm stub - cdifCore::DefinedTerm. Fattened here with the schema-required controlled-vocabulary attributes (termCode, additionalType, inDefinedTermSet) because the discovery schema references those properties.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::DefinedTerm - a schema.org DefinedTerm typically backed by a SKOS Concept. Used as the controlled-vocabulary alternative to plain strings on measurementTechnique etc.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the term.

attribute.name: termCode
attribute.definition: schema:termCode - the code identifying the term within its DefinedTermSet.

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.definition: schema:additionalType - additional type assertion for this term.

attribute.name: inDefinedTermSet
attribute.definition: schema:inDefinedTermSet - @id of the DefinedTermSet this term belongs to.

class._comment: VariableMeasured - the schema:PropertyValue form of a variable described by the dataset. Carries optional quantitative-value attributes (min/maxValue, unitCode/unitText).
class.definition: A measured variable described as a schema:PropertyValue. Lightweight discovery-level shape: name, description, optional measurement technique, optional value range (min/maxValue) and unit (unitCode/unitText). Richer per-variable structure is added by cdifDataDescription.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the variable.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - label associated with the variable in the dataset.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - free-text description of what the variable measures.

attribute.name: alternateName
attribute.definition: schema:alternateName - additional human-readable name(s) for the variable.

attribute.name: minValue
attribute.definition: schema:minValue - the lower bound of the values this variable can take (string for generality; concrete numeric type varies).

attribute.name: maxValue
attribute.definition: schema:maxValue - the upper bound of the values this variable can take.

attribute.name: unitCode
attribute.definition: schema:unitCode - URL/code identifying the unit of measure (e.g. UN/CEFACT Common Code, QUDT URI).

attribute.name: unitText
attribute.definition: schema:unitText - text label for the unit of measure (free form, complements unitCode).

class._comment: SpatialExtent - schema:Place. Geographic extent of the resource content; carries an optional Geometry via geosparql:hasGeometry / schema:geo.
class.definition: Geographic extent of the resource content (schema:Place). Carries a place name, optional identifier, and optional geometry (geosparql:hasGeometry / schema:geo).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - URI for this place (e.g. ROR identifier, gazetteer entry).

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - place name. May also be a DefinedTerm from a gazetteer.

class._comment: TemporalExtent - temporal extent of resource content. Endpoints (hasBeginning / hasEnd) can be modelled as OWL-Time Instants for structured time positions, or simply as start/end dates.
class.definition: Temporal extent of resource content - the period of time the resource covers. Endpoints can be plain XSD dates OR OWL-Time Instants (time:hasBeginning / time:hasEnd) for structured time positions.

attribute.name: startDate
attribute.definition: Start of the temporal coverage (simple-date form; structured form is time:hasBeginning -> Instant).

attribute.name: endDate
attribute.definition: End of the temporal coverage (simple-date form; structured form is time:hasEnd -> Instant).

class.definition: A W3C DQV (Data Quality Vocabulary) quality metric definition - identifies the quality property being measured.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI of the dqv:Metric.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-readable label for the metric.

class._comment: QualityMeasurement - W3C DQV quality measurement instance. Pairs a metric (dqv:isMeasurementOf -> QualityMeasure) with a measured value (dqv:value).
class.definition: A W3C DQV quality measurement: a measured value for a defined quality metric. References the metric (dqv:isMeasurementOf -> QualityMeasure) and carries the measured value (dqv:value).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI for this measurement.

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: dqv:value - the measured value (string for generality; concrete type varies by metric).

class._comment: AbstractGeometry - abstract supertype of GeoCoordinates / GeoShape (per the union-type policy: the schema:geo anyOf collapses to AbstractGeometry in the UML).
class.definition: Abstract supertype of GeoCoordinates and GeoShape - the union-type collapse target for schema:geo on a SpatialExtent. The JSON anyOf admits either subtype.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the geometry node.

class._comment: GeoCoordinates - schema.org point geometry. Generalizes AbstractGeometry.
class.definition: schema:GeoCoordinates - point geometry with latitude / longitude.

attribute.name: latitude
attribute.definition: schema:latitude - latitude of the point (number or string).

attribute.name: longitude
attribute.definition: schema:longitude - longitude of the point.

class._comment: GeoShape - schema.org bounding box / line / polygon. Generalizes AbstractGeometry.
class.definition: schema:GeoShape - shape geometry (box, line, polygon, circle).

attribute.name: box
attribute.definition: schema:box - bounding box, two lat-long pairs.

attribute.name: line
attribute.definition: schema:line - line geometry, sequence of lat-long pairs.

class._comment: Geometry - GeoSPARQL Geometry. Standalone class (NOT under AbstractGeometry) because the JSON uses geosparql:hasGeometry with WKT/CRS as its own structured property, distinct from schema:geo's GeoCoordinates/GeoShape union.
class.definition: geosparql:Geometry - structured spatial geometry serialized as Well-Known Text (geosparql:asWKT) with an optional coordinate reference system (geosparql:crs). Modelled as a real class (intentional exception to the union-shorthand: the BB defines real structure here).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the geometry node.

attribute.name: asWKT
attribute.definition: geosparql:asWKT - Well-Known Text serialization of the geometry.

attribute.name: crs
attribute.definition: geosparql:crs - coordinate reference system URI.

class._comment: Instant - OWL-Time time:Instant. Endpoint of a TemporalExtent. Intentional exception to the time:ProperInterval -> string union shorthand: the BB defines a real structured time point.
class.definition: OWL-Time time:Instant - a structured time point. Used as the value of time:hasBeginning / time:hasEnd on a TemporalExtent. Modelled as a real class because the BB defines real structure (an inTimePosition -> TimePosition reference).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the Instant.

class._comment: TimePosition - OWL-Time time:TimePosition. Numeric value + temporal reference system carried by an Instant.
class.definition: OWL-Time time:TimePosition - a numeric position on a temporal reference system. Carried by an Instant via time:inTimePosition.

attribute.name: numericPosition
attribute.definition: time:numericPosition - the numeric value (string for generality).

attribute.name: hasTRS
attribute.definition: time:hasTRS - URI of the temporal reference system the numericPosition is expressed in.

association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this dataset's metadata.

association._comment: Dataset -> DefinedTerm via schema:measurementTechnique (typed branch of the string-or-DefinedTerm union).

association.definition: schema:variableMeasured - the variables described by this dataset.
schema:spatialCoverage - geographic extent of the dataset's content.
schema:temporalCoverage - period of time the dataset covers.
dqv:hasQualityMeasurement - quality measurements reported about the dataset.
schema:measurementTechnique - measurement technique for this specific variable.

association._comment: SpatialExtent -> AbstractGeometry via schema:geo (anyOf GeoCoordinates / GeoShape, collapsed to the abstract supertype).
association.definition: schema:geo - geometry of the place. The JSON anyOf admits a GeoCoordinates (point) or GeoShape (bounding box / line) - collapsed in the UML to the AbstractGeometry supertype.

association._comment: SpatialExtent -> Geometry via geosparql:hasGeometry (the GeoSPARQL branch with WKT/CRS).

association.definition: time:hasBeginning - structured form of the start endpoint (OWL-Time Instant).
time:hasEnd - structured form of the end endpoint (OWL-Time Instant).

association._comment: TemporalExtent -> TemporalExtent via time:intervalStartedBy / time:intervalFinishedBy (interval relations).
association.definition: time:intervalStartedBy - another temporal extent that shares the start of this one (OWL-Time interval relation).
time:intervalFinishedBy - another temporal extent that shares the end of this one (OWL-Time interval relation).
time:inTimePosition - the numeric time position carried by this Instant.
dqv:isMeasurementOf - the dqv:Metric this measurement instantiates.
